scenario: [LFAC.10.1]: a fact emitted with a value read from another fact holds the value itself, and the engine leaves it unchanged when the source is retracted. Here the value is a Json slot's. `pass_on` emits Out with Payload 1's body. Then Payload 1 is retracted, Payload 2 with another body of the same shape is asserted, and a Probe makes `read_back` read Out's `j`. It must still read the body Out was emitted with, 7. A runtime whose emitted fact holds the matched fact's own tree frees Out's value at the retract, and Payload 2's tree takes the freed blocks: Out then reads 9, or the engine aborts freeing one tree twice. Path: the terminal's ASSERT action. In libds that is rete/engine.c eval_actions, which clones a Json value before ds_rete_wm_assert. In Mercury it is ds.exec.m assert_verb, whose values are immutable terms.
rules_ds:
schema Payload scope logical:
    id: Int key
    body: Json mutable

schema Out scope ttl 1_h:
    j: Json

schema Probe scope logical:
    n: Int key

rule pass_on:
    Payload p where p.id == 1
->
    emit Out j: p.body

rule read_back:
    Probe
    Out o
->
    log info "x {o.j.x}"
